notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): Benilla runs every rebindable input through one chord->command engine: canonical ALT-CTRL-SHIFT chords with the exact-modifier match law, Held latches released on the base key (chat focus clears latches without eating the release), a capture seam in the options page, and account + per-character persistence files. MSUI has a real keybindings system - a rebindable table (movement, targeting, interface panels, 12+24 action-bar buttons) with primary/secondary slots, a capture UI with unbind and reset-to-defaults, and JSON persistence with legacy-schema migration - but it binds bare keys only.
